text:
Elaine: Heads-up — our weekly KPI board shows a ~40% drop in webinar-to-MQL conversion for the last 48h vs baseline. Looks like an attribution mismatch. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/marketing/kpis
Mike (analytics): Can you paste the widget or permalink? I’ll check attribution window + UTM -> inbound match.
Elaine: Screenshot attached in thread. Also noticed landing UTMs are present but ~1/3 of leads missing lead_source tags on ingestion.
Mike (analytics): Running a quick query to validate: ```SELECT source, count(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-20' GROUP BY source;``` Possible recent change to inbound router.
Jasper: Confirmed — ops deployed inbound-router v2 on Wed 03:10 UTC, it rewrites the `source` param for a subset of redirect flows. Didn’t catch the fallback for utm_source.
Tara: What's the net impact on MQLs? We need numbers for Monday's KPI review and a short narrative for the benchmark deck.
Mike (analytics): Preliminary counts: ~320 leads this week lost a source tag; of those, ~27 were MQLs -> represents ~3% of total leads but ~37% of the webinar cohort MQLs. Updated query + dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/marketing/webinar-cohort?refresh=true
Sam: Ok — put this on the KPI review agenda. Propose a 15m slot Monday (first item) to decide rollback vs hotfix. @Tara @Jasper can you join?
Tara: Yes. I’ll prepare an attribution-sensitivity slide and a short narrative on how this moves our launch-post benchmarks.
Jasper: I’ll scope a targeted hotfix (add utm fallback write) and a safer rollout plan. If needed we can revert the router change but that’s last resort.
analytics-bot: alert: metric_anomaly detected — webinar_conv_rate down 0.38 vs 7d baseline. Ticket created: INC-4821 (assigned: Mike).
Elaine: Action items: (1) Mike share validated SQL + dashboard permalinks, (2) Jasper scope hotfix + ETA, (3) Tara prep slide for benchmarks, (4) Sam add to KPI agenda. I’ll follow up in the review. :thumbsup:
